milestone.title: raul Backlog + Ideas unification — fold Tweaks into Backlog (TW-* + BF-* + BL-*), title-bar filter chip

intent.outcome: The Backlog tab is the single surface for actionable-but-not-milestone work (tweaks, bugfixes, formally deferred scope). The Ideas tab is for exploratory/uncommitted ideas (ID-*). The Tweaks lane is gone — its data shape was identical to Backlog with a different id-prefix filter.

problem.description: Today Lane::Backlog, Lane::Tweaks, and Lane::Ideas share the same render_backlog_list renderer with id-prefix filtering — they are literally one data shape with three views. The split adds tab count and conceptual noise (what counts as a tweak vs a backlog item?) without surfacing new information. LANE_BUGFIXES (BF-*) is declared in lanes.rs but never surfaced in Lane::ordered(), so bugfixes have no tab at all. Per the user's framing: Backlog = 'issues/fix on something we have', Ideas = 'explore new things'.

in_scope: Drop Lane::Tweaks from Lane::ordered() and from the dispatcher in app.rs render() match
Update Lane::Backlog visible_backlog() to filter to id prefixes TW-* + BF-* + BL-*
Keep Lane::Ideas visible_backlog() filter to ID-* only (no change to existing behavior)
Update Lane::ordered() to 7 lanes: Overview, Milestones, Path, Backlog, Ideas, Watch, Settings
Update tab bar compact_label/label for the new ordering (no label change for Backlog or Ideas; just remove Tweaks)
Update the per-tab footer dispatch in chrome.rs to remove Tweaks-specific keys
Add a unit test pinning the Backlog prefix set (TW-* + BF-* + BL-*) and the Ideas prefix (ID-*)
out_of_scope: Filter chips in title bar (deferred — lands as part of M185's filter modal which renders the chip for Milestones; a Backlog filter chip is a separate follow-up)
Refactoring the table visual itself (deferred — M185 will lift the table helper and apply it to Milestones)
Dropping LANE_BUGFIXES or LANE_TWEAKS constants (we still reference them in tests / docs)
A new 'Bugfixes' lane — BF-* items are folded into Backlog alongside TW-* and BL-*

design_decisions.choice: No change to BacklogLine struct or to mp's mp list backlog JSON shape
design_decisions.rationale: The TUI filter is presentation-only; mp's data shape stays stable. Filter happens client-side in visible_backlog() against the cached full list — same pattern M172 S1 established for Tweaks/Ideas.

design_decisions.choice: TW-* + BF-* + BL-* as an explicit literal prefix set in visible_backlog
design_decisions.rationale: Explicit list (not regex, not starts_with-on-a-long-string) keeps the filter readable and reviewable. The user explicitly chose this set per the design discussion; encoding it inline avoids a config surface for what is, today, a presentation choice.

design_decisions.choice: Backlog draws no divider-only status bar; Ideas is structurally parallel
design_decisions.rationale: Both lanes use the same renderer with different id-prefix filters. The lane label in the title bar is the only signal — no additional chip needed pre-M185.

findings.description: visible_backlog for Lane::Backlog keeps TW-/BF-/BL-* only. mp::store::next_backlog_id assigns the B- prefix (80 B-* rows in this plan, 0 BL-*). Open formal backlog (B-85/B-87) never appears on the Backlog tab. Spec AC-02 wrote BL-* but that diverges from the data model. Fix: accept B-* (canonical) plus BL-* (alias), TW-*, BF-*; pin with a regression test using real B- ids.
findings.summary: Backlog filter uses BL-* but mp assigns B-*

findings.description: runner_helpers::load_backlog_detail walks data["items"] after reads::list_backlog, but mp list backlog emits {"backlog":[...]}. parse_backlog_lines correctly uses data["backlog"]. Enter on Backlog/Ideas (M184 consolidated path) sets ContentState::BacklogDetail but never populates app.backlog_detail — empty detail pane. Fix: read data["backlog"] (and tolerate items as fallback).
